_comment: Representation policy for scripts/json_to_ttl.py and the policy layer of scripts/validate_ttl.py. Nothing in these lists is coded in the scripts — edit here. The SHACL shapes (named_entity_shapes.ttl) hold only the structural contract; the lists below are policy and are checked against this file.
_default_match_tier: skos tier for a tool mapping nobody graded (no judge, no kg_plan, no match_tier from the mapper). closeMatch claims near-identity only.
_generic_keys: normalizedEntityKey values too generic to merge on across papers (references/key-normalization.md). A fallback key that lands here is qualified with the paper slug; the validator reports any that remain.
_interventional_evidence_bases: ner:causal-basis/* terms that license causalHypothetical false. Everything else keeps a causal claim hypothetical.

relation_predicates._comment: The closed set of paper-stated relations an extractor (per-mention `relations`, cns-cells `cell_context`) or kg_plan.json may assert: short name -> predicate IRI. `broader` (skos:broader, the in-paper hierarchy) is always allowed besides these. Add a row to allow a new predicate; the prompts, the kg-plan schema, the claims judge and the validator all read this list.

_obo_prefixes: CURIE prefixes that expand to http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/<PREFIX>_<id>. Other CURIEs expand through curie_expansions, then identifiers.org.

curie_expansions._comment: CURIE prefix -> IRI template ({id} = local part) for non-OBO id spaces. This is also the registry of KNOWN namespaces: a trusted file's class in one of these namespaces keeps this prefix, never the file's own (scripts/prefixes.py). Add a row here to register a foreign namespace.

mapping_method_by_source._comment: Mapping source (stats.alignment / item mapping_source) -> ner:mapping-method/* term for the ConceptMappingActivity.
mapping_method_by_source._ols4: curated mappings verified by a person against OLS4 (the worked example's stand-in for the remote step)

secondary_resource_classes._comment: resource-mode `mentions` lists -> class of the secondary entity

iri._comment: Resolved entities have a global deterministic IRI by canonical identity key. Source documents, mentions and relation assertions carry provenance. Local homonyms remain separate until explicit coreference resolves them; never equate entities just because their display labels match.
iri._paper: {paper} is the DOI when the source has one, else the paper slug. {variant} is the extraction (task_type:ner_domain, e.g. 'ner:neuroscience', 'ner:cns-cells'; json_to_ttl --variant): two extractions of one paper are different readings, so their mentions, classifications, reviews and runs never share an IRI. paper_shared_kinds (the publication, its text, sentences, sections) are the same thing in every extraction and are shared.

relation_range_hints._comment: Classes a relation's TARGET is expected to belong to (any subclass counts). A mismatch is a SHACL-style WARNING from validate_ttl.py, not a violation: extraction labels are coarse and the claims judge owns correctness.

labels._comment: rdfs:label is a node's short NAME (what a graph viewer shows), never an explanation: structural nodes are named by kind ('annotation v1', 'grounding review', 'mapping decision CL:0000617', 'sentence 12'); what they relate is in their properties, and prose (evidence, rationale, summaries) is a string (rdfs:comment, ner:reviewComment, ner:sentenceText). A longer name keeps its full text as rdfs:comment and is cut to max_length; validate_ttl rejects labels over it.

namespace_patterns._comment: BioPortal's own PURLs for ontologies with no OBO PURL (MESH, SNOMEDCT, LNC, OMIM, MEDLINEPLUS, ...): the acronym is the prefix. A prefix that already names another namespace (e.g. an OBO one) is never reused.
Any OBO PURL: the OBO prefix is the prefix (FBbi, CTO, ... not on the obo_prefixes list). OBO spelling is taken from the IRI itself.

_source_path: ner:sourcePath records the document's file NAME ('name', default) — never the user's local directory — or the full path ('full').

causal_value_aliases._comment: Words extractors use for the causal vocabularies -> the ontology's own terms (ner:causal-type/*, causal-modality/*, ...). A value that is neither declared nor aliased is dropped from the TTL with an rdfs:comment naming it, never written as an undeclared IRI.

unmapped_default._comment: An entity no source could map gets a deterministic BrainKB concept (base + uuid5 of 'brainkb-concept|<normalizedEntityKey>'), so every entity has a concept to query and curate; the same key gives the same concept in every paper. It is marked provisional (rdfs:comment + ner:conceptIdentifier prefix BRAINKB) and is never a claim about an external ontology; materialize or replace it separately. enabled=false restores the plain honest gap.

non_entity_filter._comment: Spans that name no referent, dropped before representation (their relations go with them) and counted in the report: a generic category noun ('cell types', 'cells', 'neuron types'), alone or led by a count or quantifier ('5,000 replicable distinguishable cell types', 'these cells', 'multiple neurons'). A numbered taxonomy name ('15 HY Gnrh1 Glut', '33 Vascular') is NOT generic and is kept. Only for labels in `labels`.
non_entity_filter.count_or_quantifier: ^(?:~|>|<|≥|≤)?\s*\d[\d,.]*\s*\+?\s+|^(?:over|more than|less than|fewer than|about|approximately|around|nearly|up to|at least|several|many|few|multiple|numerous|various|diverse|different|distinct|other|all|some|each|every|these|those|such|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|dozens of|hundreds of|thousands of|a number of|a variety of|a range of)\s+

class_from_concept._comment: An entity whose extractor label is a generic cell class (applies_to) and that is mapped at one of `tiers` to a CL term below an anchor gets that anchor's NER class too (all anchors above the term: an inhibitory interneuron is Interneuron and InhibitoryNeuron). Deterministic, from the CL hierarchy (scripts/class_anchors.py builds the table once from ontology_file). A narrowMatch or relatedMatch says nothing about what the entity IS, so it never refines.
